man.title: Site manual
man.sub: How to run every part of the shop from this back end, written for a new owner or a new team member. One chapter per section, every page with what it is, why it is there, how to use it and what each button does.
man.noGuide: This section has no page guides yet. They arrive with its pages.
man.noDocs: The guide files are not on this server yet. They are copied with every deploy.
